title: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex down 120 pts, Nifty closes at 23,398, logs 5th weekly loss as oil fears grip markets
text: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex down 120 pts, Nifty closes at 23,398, logs 5th weekly loss as oil fears grip markets. Sensex, Nifty, Stock Price Highlights: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty ended marginally lower on Friday after registering sharp losses during the day following a drop in crude oil prices and buying in blue-chip HDFC Bank and IT stocks.
